commands.integration: npm --prefix functions run build && npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --project ${GCLOUD_PROJECT:?Set GCLOUD_PROJECT} "node scripts/run-integration-report.mjs"
commands.e2eSmoke: mkdir -p out/test-results/e2e && rm -f out/test-results/e2e/junit.xml && rm -rf out/test-results/e2e/html test-results && PLAYWRIGHT_JUNIT_OUTPUT_FILE=out/test-results/e2e/junit.xml PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=out/test-results/e2e/html node scripts/run-e2e.mjs smoke && rm -rf test-results
commands.e2eFull: mkdir -p out/test-results/e2e && rm -f out/test-results/e2e/junit.xml && rm -rf out/test-results/e2e/html test-results && PLAYWRIGHT_JUNIT_OUTPUT_FILE=out/test-results/e2e/junit.xml PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=out/test-results/e2e/html node scripts/run-e2e.mjs full && rm -rf test-results
commands.stagingSmoke: mkdir -p out/test-results/e2e-staging && rm -f out/test-results/e2e-staging/junit.xml && rm -rf out/test-results/e2e-staging/html test-results && PLAYWRIGHT_JUNIT_OUTPUT_FILE=out/test-results/e2e-staging/junit.xml PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=out/test-results/e2e-staging/html node --env-file-if-exists=.env.test.staging scripts/run-e2e-staging.mjs smoke && rm -rf test-results
commands.stagingFull: mkdir -p out/test-results/e2e-staging && rm -f out/test-results/e2e-staging/junit.xml && rm -rf out/test-results/e2e-staging/html test-results && PLAYWRIGHT_JUNIT_OUTPUT_FILE=out/test-results/e2e-staging/junit.xml PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=out/test-results/e2e-staging/html node --env-file-if-exists=.env.test.staging scripts/run-e2e-staging.mjs full && rm -rf test-results
commands.ci: mkdir -p out/test-results out/test-results/e2e && node --test --experimental-strip-types --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=out/test-results/unit.junit.xml tests/unit/**/*.test.ts && npm --prefix functions run build && npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --project ${GCLOUD_PROJECT:?Set GCLOUD_PROJECT} "node scripts/run-integration-report.mjs && PLAYWRIGHT_JUNIT_OUTPUT_FILE=out/test-results/e2e/junit.xml PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=out/test-results/e2e/html node scripts/run-e2e.mjs smoke" && rm -rf test-results
